objective: Providing verbal/written schedule status updates and corrective-action impacts to senior management and stakeholders
secondaryObjectives: Communicating schedule issues that could impact scope or the schedule management plan to relevant stakeholders
Generating and maintaining schedule visibility with the project manager and stakeholders

sources.cite: PMI, PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) Examination Content Outline (2012, revision mark 4/20): Schedule Strategy 14%, Planning and Development 31%, Monitoring and Controlling 35%, Closeout 6%, Stakeholder Communications 14%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a copy of PMI's PDF hosted by a consultancy. Relevant text: Monitoring and Controlling Task 3 'Perform schedule analysis and audit ... in order to identify and report project schedule, status, changes, impacts or issues'; Task 5 'Incorporate approved risk mitigation activities into the schedule, by utilizing defined change control processes'; Task 6 'Update the schedule model and document schedule baseline changes, received through formal change-control processes'. The objective wording here is the course seed's. Reused for REQ-336 from this course's clinic-fitout-variance-pmisp (the same reading and date); the objective wording is the course seed's.

The organization, the project, the figures and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.

brief.situation: You are the scheduler for a county library system's catalog replacement, a fictional project. Data migration is three weeks behind; the steering committee meets monthly and the project manager asks you to prepare the schedule status.
handover: SPI 0.88 on migration; the go-live depends on it.
The vendor offers a weekend migration crew for 18,000 dollars.
howItWorks: The dashboard shows the commitments, the work items, the risks and issues, the people's support and the milestones.
Move on a week at a time. A decision comes to you at each status meeting; before the first, you can read the evidence.
At the end you write the record and a short reflection.

effects.finding: Weekend crew: go-live 4 September, 18,000 dollars. Phased go-live (8 branches 1 September, 4 in October): on time for most, no cost.

then.log: Week 2: the committee approves a September marketing campaign for the go-live date the schedule can't meet.
Week 3: branches go live with migration errors; 4,000 patron holds are lost.
Week 4: four branches close for training on 1 September for a system that isn't coming until October.

effects.log: Week 2: the committee asks for a recommendation.
Week 3: a phased go-live changes scope per date.

choices.label: Report SPI 0.88, the cause, the 22 September forecast and the recovery options with their impacts

effects.log: The committee sees the real status and options.

choices.feedback: Senior management needs the variance, its cause and the forecast to decide.

choices.label: Report amber with 'recovery in progress'
choices.feedback: The committee can't decide without numbers.

choices.label: Report green: the team will catch up
choices.feedback: Reporting green hides a decision the committee needs to make.

choices.label: Present both options with schedule, cost and scope impacts and recommend the phased go-live, leaving the decision to the committee

effects.log: The committee chooses the phased go-live.

choices.feedback: Corrective actions are presented with their impacts so the right level decides.

choices.label: Book the weekend crew yourself
choices.feedback: It may help, but spending isn't the scheduler's call.

choices.label: Cut migration testing to make the date
choices.feedback: Cutting quality to hold the date moves the problem into go-live.

scopePrompt.title: Who needs to know?
scopePrompt.context: The phased go-live means four branches go live in October.

choices.label: Update the schedule baseline through change control, and tell the four branch managers and the communications team with their new dates
choices.feedback: A change that affects scope dates goes through change control and to everyone it affects.

choices.label: Update the baseline only
choices.feedback: The branches plan staff training for the old date.

choices.label: Change dates in the tool without change control
choices.feedback: Uncontrolled edits leave stakeholders and the record out of step.

reflection.question: Write the status record: what you reported, how the recovery was decided and who was told.

scoring.modelReasoning: Schedule status for senior management gives the variance (SPI), its cause and the forecast, and corrective actions are presented with their schedule, cost and scope impacts so the right level decides. Changes to the baseline go through change control and are communicated to the stakeholders they affect.
